preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 30 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 for n, m, sets in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the size of X (n) is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= m <= 30 for n, m, sets in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of sets m is between 1 and 30 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= vi <= n for vi in sizes) for n, m, sets in test_cases for sizes in sets)
preconditions.description: For each set Si in each test case, the size vi of Si is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= x < n for x in set_contents) for n, m, sets in test_cases for sizes, set_contents in sets)
preconditions.description: For each set Si in each test case, each element x in Si is between 0 and n-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(len(set_contents) == vi for vi, set_contents in sets) for n, m, sets in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each set Si in each test case, the length of the set contents matches the specified size vi.

preconditions.expression: all(all(len(set_contents) == len(set(set_contents)) for vi, set_contents in sets) for n, m, sets in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each set Si in each test case, the set contents contain distinct elements.

preconditions.expression: all(all(any(x in set_contents for x in range(n)) for vi, set_contents in sets) for n, m, sets in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, each number between 0 and n-1 appears in at least one set Si.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(1 <= result <= n for result, (n, m, sets) in zip(results, test_cases))
postconditions.description: Each result is between 1 and n inclusive, where n is the size of X for the corresponding test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(any(x in atom for atom in atoms) for x in range(n)) for result, (n, m, sets), atoms in zip(results, test_cases, atom_collections))
postconditions.description: For each test case, every item in X is in some atom in the collection of atoms.

postconditions.expression: all(all(len(set(atom) & set(other_atom)) == 0 for i, atom in enumerate(atoms) for j, other_atom in enumerate(atoms) if i != j) for result, (n, m, sets), atoms in zip(results, test_cases, atom_collections))
postconditions.description: For each test case, no two atoms in the collection share a common item.

postconditions.expression: all(len(atoms) == result for result, atoms in zip(results, atom_collections))
postconditions.description: The number of atoms in the collection matches the result for each test case.
